I replied to Tobias in his #central-random thread. I said the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats, which replaces the 382 he posted in #central-team this morning. He asked for no action, so I didn't change anything else.

I also told him the 382 post and my reply confirming it are still up in #central-team. He may want to correct it there so nobody on the team uses the wrong number.

Seat counts aren't finance figures, and Tobias, Hollis and Priyanka are the only people in both channels. So mentioning both numbers in this channel didn't show anyone something they couldn't already see.
